cancel.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time via App Store settings for iOS or Google Play settings for Android. You'll retain access to premium features until the end of your billing cycle.

refund.question: What is your refund policy?
refund.answer: Apple and Google refund policies apply. You can request a refund through the respective app store within the first 14 days after purchase.

change.question: Can I change my plan?
change.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or change your plan at any time. Changes will take effect at your next billing date.

locationInfo.body: Journeo uses your location data to provide the best travel experience: GPS location for real-time navigation, showing nearby points of interest, and generating AI-powered route recommendations. Location data is only collected while using the app and is never shared without your permission.
